svg.title: Caramel, a menu for a gluten-free kitchen in Akko
svg.desc: Caramel: a menu for a gluten-free kitchen in Akko. Instead of a list, caramel pours down the page as you scroll and wraps around each dish. Lama designed it, built the whole admin side, and had the last word on every screen. It works offline and installs like an app.
svg.text: A menu for a gluten-free kitchen in Akko
Most menus are a list. On this one, caramel pours down
the page as you scroll and wraps itself around every
Nour and I built it together. I designed it, built the
whole admin side where the restaurant edits its own
menu, and I had the last word on every screen.
